title: CongestionAlertEvent
description: Event schema for congestion alerts published to the Kafka topic 'network.congestion.alerts'. Produced by the Congestion Detection Service, consumed by the Spring Boot gateway for WebSocket push to the frontend.

alert_id.description: Unique identifier for this alert event

severity.description: Severity level based on how far the actual value exceeds the threshold

source_ip.description: IP address of the traffic source that triggered the anomaly

metric.description: The network metric that was anomalous

threshold.description: The expected/normal threshold value that was exceeded

actual_value.description: The actual observed value that triggered the alert

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the anomaly was detected

detection_method.description: The algorithm used to detect this anomaly

window_size.description: Size of the statistical window used

z_score.description: Computed z-score (if z_score method was used)

iqr_deviation.description: IQR deviation factor (if IQR method was used)

consecutive_anomalies.description: Number of consecutive anomalous data points
